rationale: Report is tightly scoped to MSFT / 2026-07-30 and every key conclusion traces to the two frozen sources. Earnings figures (revenue 90.0bn +18%, operating income 40.6bn +18%, GAAP EPS 4.81 vs non-GAAP 4.74, Microsoft Cloud 59.3bn +27%, Azure +43%, FY revenue 331.8bn) are all correctly attributed to src-msft and correctly labeled as fiscal Q4 2026. Unavailable data (50/200-SMA, macro, prediction markets, global news) is honestly reported as NO_DATA_AVAILABLE rather than fabricated. EPS period discipline is exemplary: 4.81 is repeatedly identified as a single-quarter GAAP figure, annualizing it is explicitly refused, and trailing P/E is declared UNKNOWN — no trailing multiple is computed anywhere. Minor deductions: the report is long and repetitive (the same gap/extension arithmetic is restated across five role sections), and a few interpretive statements (e.g., "institutional accumulation," "capitulation-style volume") are narrative rather than sourced, though the report itself flags them as interpretation. No fabrication, no period/unit error, no unsupported valuation assertion.
